items.title: Jaylen Warren: Does little with 11 touches
items.text:
Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for one yard in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

items.title: Travis Kelce: Two TD catches in Week 11 win
items.text:
Kelce brought in six of seven targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.title: Bucky Irving: Hits 100 scrimmage yards in loss
items.text:
Irving rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 32 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: Scores TD on five catches
items.text:
St. Brown brought in five of six targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Dealing with apparent arm injury
items.text:
Barkley (left arm) said after Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers that he believes he'll play in Thursday's game at Dallas, Johnny McGonigal of PennLive.com reports.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs: Over 100 total yards in win
items.text:
Gibbs rushed 23 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns and secured four of five targets for 20 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.title: Rome Odunze: Four catches in Week 11 win
items.text:
Odunze caught all four of his targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
